PRADESHIYA SABHA - MAWANELLA MAWANELLA Pradeshiya Sabha Gazette Notiﬁ cation. Read with section 24 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act. No. 15 of 1987, published by the Hon. Governor of the Sabaragamuwa province in the special Gazette No.2316/ 29 and dated 24th January 2023 to publish notices showing the preparation of plans and list of names of the roads and narrow paths maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabhas of Sabaragamuwa Province. In accordance with the work assigned to the Pradeshiya Sabha of Sabaragamuwa Province in the series of orders herein it is hereby announced for the public's knowledge that it has been decided under Secretary's decision No.01 dated 15.01.2025 that the roads and narrow roads included in the following schedule should be declared as roads and narrow roads owned by the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha. If it is the opinion of the party claiming the said land that any road or narrow path included in the said Schedule passes through any or part of land, to ﬁ le a suit in the competent court before the expiry of three months from the date of this notiﬁ cation to prove his/ her right to the said land. And it is further announced that every road and narrow path included in the said Schedule for which no case has been assigned before the expiry of the said period of three months shall be deemed to be a road or narrow path owned by the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha.
Dඎආංඇൽൺ C. Wංർ඄උൾආൺඌංඇ඀ඁൾ, Secretary and implementation oﬃ cer, Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha.
At Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha, Mawanella,15th of January, 2025.
